_note: Plain-English wording for The Four Desks, written once and stored so the demo needs no API key. Regenerate with: python -m narrate_example --api-key sk-ant-... --name desks . Keys are group ids from to_ai_payload; every id must appear exactly once, which narrate.problems_with checks and a test enforces against the live trace.

prose.1: "Ana sits at desk 1" settles her straight away: she is at no other desk, and nobody else can be at desk 1.
prose.2: With Ben, Cara and Dev all shut out of desk 1, Ana is who remains there.
prose.3: Ben sits immediately to the left of Cara, so Ben cannot be at desk 4 — there would be no desk to his right for Cara.
prose.4: Ben is not at desk 1, and Cara sits immediately to his right, so Cara cannot be at desk 2.
prose.5: Ben drinks the coffee, and desk 1 is not Ben, so desk 1 is not the coffee.
prose.6: Ben is not at desk 4 either, so the coffee is not there.
prose.7: The friend with the dog drinks coffee, and there is no coffee at desk 1, so the dog is not at desk 1.
prose.8: Same at desk 4: no coffee there, so no dog either.
prose.9: Cara keeps the fish, and desk 1 is not Cara, so the fish is not at desk 1.
prose.10: Cara is not at desk 2 either, so the fish is not there.
prose.11: The fish owner drinks juice, and the fish is not at desk 1, so the juice is not at desk 1.
prose.12: Nor at desk 2, for the same reason — no fish there, so no juice.
prose.13: The green desk sits immediately to the right of the blue one, so blue cannot be desk 4 and green cannot be desk 1. Neither has room for its partner.
prose.14: The bird has to sit next to the fish, and the only desk beside desk 1 is desk 2 — which cannot have the fish. So the bird cannot be at desk 1 either way round.
prose.15: Desk 1 has no dog, no fish and no bird left, so Ana keeps the cat.
prose.16: Checking the bird on both sides of the fish again, desk 2 comes out with neither the bird nor the cat.
prose.17: The fish was already out of desk 2, so with the cat and bird gone too, Ben's desk has the dog.
prose.18: The same both-ways check clears the dog and the cat from desk 3, and the cat from desk 4.
prose.19: The yellow desk is at one end of the row, so whichever end that turns out to be, desks 2 and 3 are not yellow.
prose.20: The dog's owner drinks coffee, and desk 3 has no dog, so it has no coffee.
prose.21: The cat owner drinks tea, and desk 2 has no cat, so it has no tea.
prose.22: Desk 3 has no cat either, so no tea there.
prose.23: Nor at desk 4 — no cat, so no tea.
prose.24: Whichever side of the fish the bird sits on, desk 1 comes out without the water.
prose.25: No coffee, no juice and no water leaves only the tea for Ana at desk 1.
prose.26: The same check rules the water out of desk 2.
prose.27: With tea, juice and water all gone from desk 2, the coffee is what is left.
prose.28: Ben drinks the coffee, and desk 3 has none, so Ben is not at desk 3.
prose.29: The tea drinker sits at the red desk, and desk 2 has no tea, so desk 2 is not red.
prose.30: Desk 3 has no tea either, so it is not red.
prose.31: Nor is desk 4 — no tea there, so not red.
prose.32: Working through both sides of the fish once more rules Dev out of desk 2.
prose.33: Ana, Cara and Dev are all out of desk 2, so Ben sits there.
prose.34: The same check clears desk 1 of both yellow and blue.
prose.35: Green was already impossible at desk 1, so with yellow and blue gone the desk must be red — which fits, since Ana drinks the tea.
prose.36: Checking both ways round again, desk 4 cannot be green.
prose.37: Red, blue and green are all ruled out at desk 4, so it is the yellow one — the end of the row, as the clue promised.
prose.38: Ben is not at desk 3, and Cara sits immediately to his right, so Cara is not at desk 4.
prose.39: Ana, Ben and Cara are all placed elsewhere, so Dev has desk 4.
prose.40: Cara keeps the fish and Cara is not at desk 4, so the fish is not there.
prose.41: No cat, no dog and no fish at desk 4 leaves the bird for Dev.
prose.42: The fish owner drinks juice, and there is no fish at desk 4, so no juice either.
prose.43: Tea, coffee and juice are all out at desk 4, so Dev drinks the water.
prose.44: Green is not at desk 4, and green sits immediately right of blue, so blue is not at desk 3.
prose.45: Desk 3 is not red, not blue and not yellow, so it is green.
prose.46: Blue is not at desk 1, and green sits immediately to its right, so green is not at desk 2.
prose.47: That leaves blue for desk 2 — red, green and yellow are all spoken for.
prose.48: One more pass over both sides of the fish rules Dev out of desk 3.
prose.49: Ana, Ben and Dev are all elsewhere, so Cara sits at desk 3.
prose.50: The same check rules the water out of desk 3.
prose.51: Tea, coffee and water are all placed, so Cara drinks the juice — which fits, since she keeps the fish.
prose.52: And the last both-ways check rules the bird out of desk 3.
prose.53: The cat and the bird are gone from desk 3, so Cara keeps the fish — and every desk is now settled.
